unit: Phase 03A regression matrix at the v4-r4 candidate freeze

fullJest.classification: ALL INHERITED. Every failing suite is a UI, accessibility, geometry or copy guard (tab bars, modals, keyboard surfaces, privacy screen text, map chrome). None touches guest ingestion, rate limiting, flags or feedback.
fullJest.structuralProof: v4 changed ZERO .ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx/.json files. git diff against the frozen source shows only two SQL candidate files plus a new supabase/tests/fda028 directory of SQL and one shell script. src/, App.tsx, package.json, package-lock.json, schema.generated.sql and the 71 applied migrations are all byte-identical. It is therefore structurally impossible for v4 to have caused any Jest failure.
